run_batch_reasoning_generation: run batch reasoning data generation using a GPT or HuggingFace model on training queries
run_direct_reasoning_generation: run direct reasoning data generation without batching by passing the --no_batch flag
gather_batch_results: gather and collect results from a previously submitted batch API job using --gather_results
run_debug_generation: run reasoning generation in debug mode with --debug to process only a single sample
run_subject_filtered_generation: run reasoning data generation filtered by a specific subject or dataset like biology or msmarco
